correctness.rationale: For Cn with ai<bi,bi+1 and n≥2 the 4n distinct comparable ordered pairs in the deleted product form an antichain. Each has exactly one strict lower pair obtained by replacing its upper coordinate by the alternative lower neighbor; the map fixing incomparable pairs and sending comparable pairs to their unique predecessor is monotone with r≤id, hence a strong deformation retraction. It is equivariant since unique strict predecessor is intrinsic and preserves order automorphisms/particle swap. For n≥3 two-neighbor sets are distinct: for every surviving AA,BB or AB,BA point the upper/lower cones have no beat witness; n2 survivor has 4-point crown, also core. |K|=2n(2n−3). For n≥3 a three-point strict chain exists but none with four points, so height3 vs height2 crown cores and finite-space homotopy non-equivalence. Small n2..8 exhaustive distinct-pair and beat witness checks independently reproduced; n2..5 beat-freeness independently tested; all-n proof is symbolic, not extrapolated from these checks.
